business: Mitra (beta), a collab marketplace for Bengaluru Instagram creators
by_segment: Micro creator (10K-50K followers), does a few paid collabs a month
Nano creator (2K-10K followers), student or day job, mostly barter so far
Established local creator (50K-100K followers), collabs are real income, may have a manager
why_not: I've been burned by a fake agency already, so a beta app from a small team I've never heard of that wants my Instagram and sends messages from my account is a hard no for now. My WhatsApp groups already flag the obvious scams, and most of the café offers are food not cash, so there's not much to take 5% of or chase payment on.

I'd maybe try the free scam check on a couple of leads from my WhatsApp groups, but Pro's main thing is auto-DM, and that's exactly what could get my account flagged. My reach is everything right now, so I'm not paying to put it at risk, even if it's only 199.

Most of what I get is barter from small cafes and salons, maybe one paid offer in a month, so I'd try the free version for the scam check but I don't see why I'd pay for Pro yet. It also doesn't bring me any new brands, it only manages the ones I already find through my WhatsApp groups.

Most of my collabs are barter, so a fair-rate check, payment reminders and a 5% cut don't do much for me yet. What I want is more followers and reach, and the only growth bit here, auto-DM to commenters, is locked behind Pro. I might try the free version once, but I wouldn't pay for it.

I never pay for creator tools, so Pro at ₹199 is a no even if it's cheap. I might try the free scam check on one of those sketchy DMs, but I'm not handing over 5% of a deal I could have negotiated myself or with my manager.

I already apply to campaigns on Influish, and the barter offers come straight to my DMs, so I don't see a reason to pay for another app. I might try the free version to check a dodgy offer, but I won't pay for Pro or give up 5% in the first month.
flip: Two or three creators I actually know from my WhatsApp groups vouching that it caught a real scam or got them paid on a late deal, and a way to use the scam check by just pasting an offer without connecting my account.
